seo.title: Share Your Food Log With Your Dietitian | Caltrac
seo.description: Install Caltrac on iPhone or Android, enter your professional's code and send a request to share your meals. Stop sharing any time.
seo.h1: How to share your meals with your dietitian, nutritionist or trainer

intro.body: To share your meals, install Caltrac, enter the linking code your professional gave you in Caltrac Connect, and send a request. Once your professional accepts it, they can see the meals you log and comment on them. You can stop sharing at any time.

connect.heading: What is Caltrac Connect?
connect.body: Caltrac Connect is an optional feature in the Caltrac app, opened from the button in the app's top bar. It lets you connect with a nutritionist, dietitian or trainer, who can then view your meals and leave comments. You control access and can revoke it at any time.

before.heading: Before you start
before.body: You need the Caltrac app and your professional's linking code. Professionals receive their code after Caltrac approves their account.

canSee.heading: What your professional can see
canSee.body: Your meals, your nutrition goals and how your net calories compare with those goals. They can also comment on your meals. They see these only after they accept your request.

cannot.heading: What they can't do
cannot.body: They can't search for you, invite you or add you. Every link starts with you.

stopping.heading: Stopping sharing
stopping.body:
You can stop sharing at any time. You don't need anyone's approval, and it takes effect immediately.

Open Caltrac Connect, tap your professional, then Revoke access, and confirm.

On Android, a request that is still pending can be withdrawn: tap it, then Withdraw request.

steps.text: Install Caltrac on iPhone or Android.
Tap Caltrac Connect in the app's top bar, choose Connect a professional, and enter your professional's linking code.
Send the request. Sharing starts when your professional accepts.
Log your meals with a photo or a short description. Their comments appear next to the meals.

items.question: My professional doesn't have a code yet.
items.answer: They can apply to join at the [Caltrac for Professionals Home page](/). Once approved, they'll receive a code.

items.question: Is Caltrac free?
items.answer: Caltrac is free to use, with no subscriptions.
